title: Which traces does a combat death leave in an ordinary corpus run, and which of them could a co-located or bonded observer legitimately receive?
summary: Confirmed empirically that combat deaths occur and enumerated their traces; only the grief trigger (bonded allies only, no proximity check) is encounterable by any observer today, all other traces are not.

title: Bounded reachability assessment for three mechanisms — calamity_intensity, regional_trauma, and aging_death/succession — answering whether each is a condition, a defect, or a mislabel
summary: Classified calamity_intensity as DEFECT (routed as recommendation to TCK-20260923-MECHANISM-IMPLEMENTED-BY-RESIDUE-RESOLUTION) and regional_trauma/aging_death-succession as CONDITION, with four-level reachability evidence and new regression-pinning tests, no src/ or registry writes.
